game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Orchard Lane, the royal orchard lane: the knight must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Print Probe: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before thieves act.
theme: The Kingdom – Orchard Lane: the royal orchard lane
core_gameplay_loop: In Orchard Lane, repeat each round: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before thieves act. Each round, thieves strike the royal seal, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the shield value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the royal seal from thieves in Orchard Lane: keep the shield meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 51-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: shield drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 51-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 8 (extended tier): Print Probe
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Probe' (Week 1 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Orchard Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how shield changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Orchard Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 51 seconds while shield > 0.
